name: io.github.flow-steward/jenkins
title: Jenkins
description: Inspect jobs, trigger builds and read build logs and status on your own Jenkins controller through…

instance_host.description: Host name of your Jenkins controller (the Jenkins URL from Manage Jenkins > System, without https://). If Jenkins runs under a context path such as /jenkins, the endpoint is <jenkins-url>/mcp-server/mcp. (for example: ci.acme.com)

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: base64 of '<jenkins-username>:<api-token>' (echo -n 'user:token' | base64). Create the API token under your user > Security > API Token. Enter it as: Basic <value>
